label: Isotopic Resource Map
description: An interactive overlay for the dig-site map that displays the feeding ranges and migratory paths of herbivores based on dental geochemistry.

layers.label: Geological Signature
layers.function: Shows which dinosaurs stayed in the river delta vs. the upland forests.

layers.label: Water Source Map
layers.function: Tracks seasonal migration based on the 'heaviness' of the water the animals drank.

game_mechanics.ecological_niche_discovery: By mapping 10+ teeth, the player unlocks a 'Life History' trophy for that species, revealing exactly what they ate.
game_mechanics.community_analysis: Comparing Triceratops and Hadrosaur maps reveals if they were competing for the same food or 'partitioning' the environment.
